detail.title: Structural Changes in Investment and the Waning Power of Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1190
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We argue that secular change in both the production and composition of investment goods has weakened investment's role in the transmission of monetary policy to labor earnings and consumption. We show analytically that fluctuations in the production of investment goods amplify the response of consumption to monetary policy shocks by varying labor income for hand-to-mouth agents. We document three secular changes weakening this channel: (i) labor's share of value added in investment goods production has declined, (ii) the import share of investment goods has risen, and (iii) the composition of investment has shifted towards components that are less responsive to monetary policy. A small open economy, two agent New Keynesian model calibrated to match these facts implies a 23 percent weaker response of labor income and a 17 percent weaker response of consumption to real interest rate shocks in a 2020s economy relative to a 1960s economy.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，投资品生产和构成的变化削弱了投资在货币政策传导中的作用，导致货币政策对劳动收入和消费的影响减弱。
AI.research_question: 投资品生产和构成的变化如何影响货币政策向劳动收入和消费的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 传统上投资是货币政策传导的重要渠道，但近年来投资对货币政策的响应减弱，需要探究其背后的结构性变化原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于小型开放经济体的两代理人新凯恩斯模型，分析投资品生产波动如何通过影响手头拮据代理人的劳动收入来放大消费对货币政策的响应。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证检验：1) 分析投资品生产波动对消费的影响机制；2) 实证记录三个结构性变化；3) 构建校准模型比较1960年代和2020年代经济对实际利率冲击的响应差异。
AI.findings: 发现三个结构性变化：1) 投资品生产中劳动份额下降；2) 投资品进口份额上升；3) 投资构成转向对货币政策响应较弱的组件。模型显示2020年代经济对实际利率冲击的劳动收入响应比1960年代弱23%，消费响应弱17%。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于阐明了投资品生产和构成变化如何通过劳动收入渠道影响货币政策传导，为理解货币政策有效性变化提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义在于帮助政策制定者理解货币政策传导机制的变化，为制定更有效的货币政策提供依据，特别是在全球化背景下投资品生产和贸易模式变化的环境中。

title: Platformisation and Precariousness: A Socio-economic Profile of Gig Workers in Nagpur and the Challenge for Viksit Bharat
affiliations: RTM Nagpur University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Platformisation and Precariousness: A Socio-economic Profile of Gig Workers in Nagpur and the Challenge for Viksit Bharat
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the socioeconomic profile and income security of platform-based gig workers in Nagpur, India, drawing on a survey of 370 respondents. It finds a predominantly male, young, and educated workforce engaged across food delivery, mobility, and homeservice platforms. A striking 56.8% of workers are income-insecure, earning less than ₹20,000 per month. The study reveals significant platform-level segmentation, with food delivery workers facing the highest insecurity (73.5%). Bivariate analysis shows a counterintuitive link between dependency burden and income security, suggesting that workers with more dependents may intensify their labour. Crucially, logistic regression confirms that platform type is the single most significant predictor of income insecurity, while individual factors like age of workforce entry or nature of income (primary/secondary) are not. This challenges the narrative of gig work as a flexible supplement and highlights structural precarity. The paper concludes by framing these findings as a critical challenge to India's Viksit Bharat mission, arguing that sustainable and inclusive development is unattainable without formalizing and ensuring dignified incomes for the growing platform-based workforce.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了印度那格浦尔平台零工工人的社会经济状况和收入保障，发现超过一半的工人收入不安全，平台类型是收入不安全的最重要预测因素，挑战了零工工作作为灵活补充的叙事。
AI.research_question: 印度那格浦尔平台零工工人的社会经济特征和收入保障状况如何？哪些因素影响他们的收入安全？
AI.motivation: 随着平台零工经济的快速增长，需要了解这一新兴劳动力的社会经济状况和收入保障，特别是对印度"Viksit Bharat"（发达印度）使命的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台劳动理论、收入安全概念、劳动力市场分割理论、结构性不稳定理论
AI.method: 对370名平台零工工人进行问卷调查，使用双变量分析和逻辑回归分析数据
AI.findings: 1. 工人主要为男性、年轻、受过教育；2. 56.8%收入不安全（月收入低于2万卢比）；3. 平台间存在显著分割，外卖配送工人最不安全（73.5%）；4. 平台类型是收入不安全的最重要预测因素；5. 个体因素如工作起始年龄或收入性质影响不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了零工工作作为灵活补充收入的叙事，强调平台经济的结构性不稳定，为平台劳动分割理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供数据支持，强调需要正式化和保障平台工人尊严收入，对印度"Viksit Bharat"使命提出警示

title: The Impact of Innovation on Economic Complexity: The Role of Institutions

detail.title: The Impact of Innovation on Economic Complexity: The Role of Institutions

publicationDetails.detailsText: East Asian Economic Review vol. 30 no. 1 (March 2026) p. 35-57, https://dx.doi.org/10.11644/KIEP.EAER.2026.30.1.460
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Institutions play a significant role in spurring a country's innovative activities. However, to the best of our knowledge, the relative importance of institutions in the innovationeconomic complexity link remains unexplored. This study examines the role of institutional quality in moderating the impact of innovation on economic complexity for 68 countries from 1996 to 2020. We employed various estimation techniques for the analysis, including the generalized method of moments (GMM), pooled ordinary least squares (OLS), fixedeffects, and random-effects regression. In this study, economic complexity is measured using the Economic Complexity Index (ECI), which captures a country's productive capabilities. At the same time, institutional quality (INS) is constructed from the six governance dimensions of the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI). The GMM estimator results reveal that institutions are significant determinants on the innovationeconomic complexity link. The positive impact of innovation on economic complexity becomes higher when institutional quality is stronger. Furthermore, institutions and innovation were found to have a direct influence on economic complexity. We are also utilizing research and development (R&D) expenditure as a proxy for innovation, which resulted in similar results. Finally, only export, foreign direct investment (FDI), and capital investment are significant in explaining economic complexity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨制度质量在创新与经济复杂性关系中的调节作用，发现制度质量越高，创新对经济复杂性的正向影响越强。
AI.research_question: 制度质量如何调节创新对经济复杂性的影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然制度在促进国家创新活动中发挥重要作用，但制度在创新与经济复杂性关系中的相对重要性尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学理论，创新与经济增长理论，经济复杂性理论
AI.method: 使用广义矩估计(GMM)、混合OLS、固定效应和随机效应回归，分析1996-2020年68个国家的面板数据。经济复杂性用经济复杂性指数(ECI)衡量，制度质量基于世界治理指标的六个维度构建。
AI.findings: 1. 制度是创新与经济复杂性关系的重要决定因素；2. 制度质量越强，创新对经济复杂性的正向影响越大；3. 制度和创新都对经济复杂性有直接影响；4. 使用研发支出作为创新代理变量得到相似结果；5. 只有出口、外商直接投资和资本投资对经济复杂性有显著解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次探索制度在创新与经济复杂性关系中的调节作用，丰富了制度经济学与创新理论的交叉研究，为理解制度、创新和经济复杂性之间的互动机制提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，强调在推动创新和经济复杂性提升时，需要同时关注制度质量的改善，特别是出口、外商直接投资和资本投资等关键因素的管理。

detail.abstract: This study examines whether Korea's export controls and foreign investment restrictions under the Industrial Technology Protection Act and the National High-Tech Strategic Industries Act can be justified under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (hereinafter "GATT") Article XXI's national security exception. Based on World Trade Organization (hereinafter "WTO") rulings, it finds that measures driven by economic or political motives may lack legal legitimacy. The study calls for advanced assessments to determine the national security implications of technology leakage, along with inter-ministerial cooperation systems and the establishment of expert legal review bodies to ensure procedural consistency and compliance with international norms.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了韩国《产业技术保护法》和《国家高科技战略产业法》下的出口管制和外商投资限制措施是否符合GATT第21条国家安全例外条款。基于WTO裁决，研究发现出于经济或政治动机的措施可能缺乏法律正当性。研究建议建立技术泄露国家安全影响评估机制、部际合作体系和专家法律审查机构，以确保程序一致性和国际规范合规性。
AI.research_question: 韩国的出口管制和外商投资限制措施是否符合GATT第21条国家安全例外条款？
AI.motivation: 随着技术竞争加剧，各国采取各种贸易限制措施保护关键技术。韩国通过《产业技术保护法》和《国家高科技战略产业法》实施出口管制和投资限制，但这些措施是否符合WTO规则中的国家安全例外条款需要法律评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: GATT第21条国家安全例外条款、WTO争端解决机制相关裁决、国际法中的国家安全例外原则、贸易保护主义与国家安全边界的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于WTO裁决的法律分析、案例研究、比较法分析、韩国相关法律文本分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 基于经济或政治动机的措施可能不符合GATT第21条国家安全例外；2) 需要明确区分国家安全关切与经济保护主义；3) 当前措施缺乏充分的法律正当性评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 丰富了国家安全例外条款在技术保护领域的适用边界理论；2) 提出了区分国家安全与经济动机的分析框架；3) 为技术相关贸易限制措施的法律评估提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议建立技术泄露国家安全影响评估机制；2) 提出建立部际合作体系；3) 建议设立专家法律审查机构；4) 为政策制定者提供确保国际规范合规性的操作指南。

detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive review of the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) employment projection methodologies as documented in official BLS publications, including the Handbook of Methods, Monthly Labor Review articles, and technical documentation. The BLS Employment Projections program produces essential long-term forecasts of the labor force, industry output, and occupational employment that inform national policy and workforce development strategies. This review systematically examines the core methodological components: labor force projections using demographic models, macroeconomic projections of GDP and its components, industry output and employment projections using input-output analysis, and occupational employment projections based on industry staffing patterns. We analyze key technical documents including the occupational separations methodology, gross flows estimation frameworks, Bayesian inference for survey estimation, hedonic quality adjustment methods, multiple imputation techniques for missing data, and productivity measurement approaches. The review synthesizes findings from recent methodological innovations published in the Monthly Labor Review and working paper series, identifying strengths, limitations, and opportunities for enhancement. This comprehensive examination serves as a foundation for understanding how BLS methodologies might evolve to address emerging measurement challenges while maintaining historical continuity and statistical rigor.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国劳工统计局（BLS）就业预测方法进行了全面回顾，系统分析了其劳动力预测、宏观经济预测、行业产出与就业预测、职业就业预测等核心方法组件，并评估了方法创新与改进机会。
AI.research_question: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）就业预测方法的核心技术组件是什么？这些方法有哪些优势、局限性和改进机会？
AI.motivation: BLS就业预测项目为美国国家政策和劳动力发展战略提供重要的长期预测，需要系统理解其方法论基础，以应对新兴测量挑战并保持统计严谨性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人口统计学的劳动力预测模型、宏观经济预测理论、投入产出分析、行业人员配置模式分析、贝叶斯推断、享乐质量调整方法、多重插补技术、生产率测量方法等统计和经济理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统分析BLS官方出版物（包括方法手册、月度劳工评论文章和技术文档）中的方法论文档，综合评估核心预测组件和技术创新。
AI.findings: BLS就业预测方法包含四大核心组件：基于人口模型的劳动力预测、GDP及其组成部分的宏观经济预测、基于投入产出分析的行业产出与就业预测、基于行业人员配置模式的职业就业预测。方法具有统计严谨性和历史连续性，但也面临新兴测量挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了BLS就业预测的理论方法体系，为理解官方统计预测方法提供了综合框架，识别了方法论创新与改进的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和劳动力发展专业人士提供了理解BLS预测方法的基础，帮助评估预测结果的可靠性和局限性，并为方法改进提供实践指导。

The author confirms that this affiliation has not influenced the design, conduct, or reporting of this work.

publicationDetails.journalName: Canadian Law Review Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution of the enforceability of contracts across common law jurisdictions. It traces the shift from an objective approach, which focuses on the outward expressions of agreement between parties, prevalent in the early to mid-20th century, to a more subjective and equitable approach employed in the late 20th century, which considers the fairness and intentions behind the agreements. In the last few decades, the approach has once again shifted, becoming more conservative and less settled. The paper delves into key judicial decisions related to two major concepts: consideration (the value exchanged in a contract) and consensus ad idem (mutual agreement). These concepts will be applied to recent and highly tendentious matters of forum exclusion clauses in adhesion contracts. By analyzing case law and judicial decisions, the paper highlights the ongoing debate between different legal philosophies and the challenge of balancing stability in the law with achieving justice in individual cases. Ultimately, it argues that understanding these shifts is crucial for navigating modern contractual disputes, particularly as new commercial realities, such as the digital and globalized economy, expose deeper tensions between formalist and equitable approaches to consensus, consideration, and the enforceability of contractual terms.

AI.tldr: 该论文追踪了普通法系中合同可执行性的演变：从20世纪早中期关注外在表达形式的客观主义方法，到20世纪晚期更注重公平和意图的主观衡平法方法，再到近几十年趋于保守且不稳定的现状。论文通过分析对价和合意两大核心概念的相关判例，探讨了格式合同中法院选择条款等争议问题，揭示了法律稳定性与个案正义之间的张力。
AI.research_question: 普通法系中合同可执行性的法律原则如何演变？特别是对价和合意概念如何适应现代商业实践（如格式合同中的法院选择条款）？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济和全球化带来的新商业现实，格式合同中的法院选择条款等争议问题暴露了形式主义与衡平法方法之间的深层张力。理解合同可执行性原则的历史演变对于应对现代合同纠纷至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 客观主义方法（形式主义）：关注合同的外在表达形式
2. 主观衡平法方法：强调公平原则和当事人的真实意图
3. 对价理论：合同中的价值交换原则
4. 合意理论：当事人之间的相互同意
5. 法律稳定性与个案正义的平衡理论
AI.method: 案例分析法：通过分析普通法系的关键司法判例，追踪对价和合意概念的历史演变，特别关注格式合同中法院选择条款的相关争议案件。
AI.findings:
1. 20世纪早中期：客观主义方法主导，强调合同外在形式
2. 20世纪晚期：转向主观衡平法方法，注重公平和意图
3. 近几十年：方法变得保守且不稳定，反映了法律哲学的持续辩论
4. 格式合同中的法院选择条款成为检验这些原则的重要试验场
5. 数字经济和全球化加剧了形式主义与衡平法方法之间的张力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 系统梳理了普通法系合同可执行性原则的三阶段演变模型
2. 将对价和合意理论与现代格式合同实践相结合
3. 揭示了法律稳定性需求与个案正义追求之间的根本张力
4. 为理解数字时代合同法的适应性提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为律师处理格式合同纠纷提供历史视角和判例指导
2. 帮助企业理解法院选择条款等争议条款的可执行性风险
3. 为法官在形式主义与衡平法之间寻求平衡提供参考
4. 为立法者和政策制定者改革合同法提供实证基础

title: Vibe Coding Authorship
affiliations: Santa Clara University - School of Law

detail.title: Vibe Coding Authorship

publicationDetails.journalName: Santa Clara University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Copyright law faces seismic disruptions caused by artificial intelligence (AI). "Vibe coding"-or a person's use of natural-language prompts to an AI generator for it to write the actual lines of computer code-has led to a copyright contraction. Under the restrictive view of "human authorship" adopted by the U.S. Copyright Office, both the availability and the scope of copyright for computer programs have dramatically narrowed with the greater adoption of vibe coding by both businesses and individuals to create computer programs. Vibe-coded programs are but one example of a much larger phenomenon of copyright contraction affecting a wide array of promptengineered works, including textual works, visual works, audiovisual works and motion pictures, and music. The Copyright Office's restrictive approach has disqualified these works as uncopyrightable if they were created by a person's "prompts alone." And the Office has imposed a duty on applicants for registration of a work they created to disclaim any AI-generated element. 

This Essay is one of the first in legal scholarship to analyze the growing problem of copyright contraction for computer programs that few in the software and tech industries even recognize. As an alternative to the Copyright Office's restrictive approach, the Essay offers a proposal for how courts should analyze the copyrightability of vibe-coded computer programs. Under the courts' longstanding precedents, people who make an original selection and arrangement of elements through vibe codingincluding in structuring the modules or architecture of computer programs, or in the visual or audiovisual displays from the program-qualify as authors. But, if authorship is based on selection and arrangement, the scope of copyright is thin, protecting only against near identical copies of the respective works. And, to the extent this thin copyright protection is inadequate, Congress should consider enacting a limited sui generis protection for vibe-coded computer programs. This Essay's proposal serves the constitutional goal of promoting progress and incentivizing people to create works for the public's benefit. And it incentivizes businesses to employ human creators instead of seeking to completely automate the production of computer programs by AI agents.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了AI生成的"氛围编码"计算机程序引发的版权收缩问题，批判了美国版权局过于严格的"人类作者"标准，并提出法院应基于原创性选择和编排来认定版权，同时建议国会考虑制定专门的特殊保护制度。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，如何解决"氛围编码"计算机程序引发的版权收缩问题，平衡版权保护与技术创新之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 人工智能特别是"氛围编码"（通过自然语言提示让AI生成代码）导致计算机程序版权保护范围急剧缩小，美国版权局的严格标准使得许多AI辅助创作的作品无法获得版权保护，这对软件和技术行业产生了重大影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国版权法的"人类作者"原则、原创性标准、选择和编排理论，以及宪法中"促进进步"的目标。
AI.method: 法律分析方法和政策建议方法，通过分析现有版权法判例、版权局政策，提出司法和立法层面的解决方案。
AI.findings: 1. 美国版权局的严格标准导致AI生成作品的版权收缩；2. 法院应基于原创性选择和编排来认定版权；3. 这种保护范围较窄，只能防止近乎相同的复制；4. 需要国会考虑制定专门的特殊保护制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在AI时代重新思考版权法中"作者"概念的理论框架，强调选择和编排作为版权认定的关键标准，为AI生成作品的版权保护提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院审理AI生成作品版权案件提供了具体分析框架，为国会立法提供了政策建议，帮助软件行业理解版权风险，激励企业雇佣人类创作者而非完全依赖AI自动化。

title: The ‘Black Women Best’ Framework: Intergenerational Transfer Taxes And The Racial Wealth Gap
affiliations: Institute on Taxation and Economic Policy (ITEP) and University of Nevada, Las Vegas - William S. Boyd School of Law

detail.title: The ‘Black Women Best’ Framework: Intergenerational Transfer Taxes And The Racial Wealth Gap
detail.abstract:
“Black Women Best” (BWB) is an analytical framework that posits focusing on the economic wellbeing of Black women as an effective way to monitor the general health of the broader economy. The theory is that if Black women are successful in the economy, then other marginalized groups and the overall economy will be successful as well. This framework in the context of reducing the racial wealth gap is consistent with the demonstrated connection between race and wealth inequality. Economists have found that historic discrimination and economic exclusion have contributed to significant wealth gaps between white and Black households, and low- and high-wealth households. 

The continued growth of this gap stems at least partly from tax policies that advantage high-wealth households, who are disproportionately white and male. Specifically, recent trends in federal and state legislative tax policies that favor tax cuts for high-income households and corporations have only further fueled these divides. Because of their race and gender status, Black women are acutely affected by these wealth gaps. This means effective tax policies must address both statuses to improve their economic wellbeing and, in turn, equalize broader economic wellbeing. Because the BWB framework targets these issues it is well suited to tax policies that will mitigate rather than exacerbate the racial wealth gap.

A significant source of household wealth is intergenerational wealth transfers or inheritances. Black women, similar to other marginalized groups, do not benefit from inheritances. Indeed, these communities are often supporting and subsidizing the well-being of their parents and grandparents. White households are three times more likely to receive an inheritance than Black households. The gap in intergenerational transfers of wealth is a significant contributing factor to the wealth gap between white and Black families. Tax policies such as targeted inheritance taxes can mitigate this disparity.

This essay will make the case that inheritance taxes better align the economy for a fairer and more just system for all participants. The essay uses the BWB framework and data from the Survey of Consumer Finances to show the state of the racial wealth divide and inheritances in the country. The BWB framework demonstrates how these disparities particularly undermine the well-being of Black women. The history of inheritances over time is an important part of explaining the importance of this critical tool in wealth redistribution. Moreover, reviewing the history will expose the devastating consequences of recent reductions in these taxes for Black women and in turn all households. The essay next exposes how these unfair tax policies have shaped inheritance practices that have led to white households leaving escalating estates to their heirs over time. Finally, we conclude our paper showing how the BWB framework reveals the possibilities of using federal- and state-level inheritance taxes to make the racial wealth gap and the economy more equitable for low-income households and communities of color. 

While recent federal judicial rulings suggest there are barriers to inheritance and other wealth targeted taxes, enactment of federal inheritance taxes are not unattainable. State legislative victories and trends, and recent state judicial rulings suggest increasing the number of states with inheritance taxes may also be a viable option to systematically reduce the racial wealth divide across the country.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"黑人女性最佳"分析框架，认为关注黑人女性的经济福祉可以有效监测整体经济健康。文章主张通过遗产税政策来缩小种族财富差距，特别关注黑人女性因种族和性别双重身份而受到的不平等影响。
AI.research_question: 如何利用"黑人女性最佳"框架设计遗产税政策，以缩小种族财富差距并促进整体经济公平？
AI.motivation: 历史歧视和经济排斥导致白人和黑人家庭之间显著的财富差距，而有利于高财富家庭（主要是白人和男性）的税收政策进一步加剧了这种不平等。黑人女性因种族和性别双重身份受到特别严重的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: "黑人女性最佳"分析框架：关注黑人女性的经济福祉可以作为监测整体经济健康的有效指标。该框架认为，如果黑人女性在经济上成功，其他边缘化群体和整体经济也会成功。
AI.method: 使用"黑人女性最佳"分析框架，结合消费者财务调查数据，分析种族财富差距和遗产继承现状。通过历史分析揭示遗产税在财富再分配中的重要性。
AI.findings: 1. 白人家庭获得遗产的可能性是黑人家庭的三倍；2. 代际财富转移差距是种族财富差距的重要成因；3. 近期遗产税削减对黑人女性造成了特别严重的负面影响；4. 不公平的税收政策导致白人家庭遗产规模随时间不断增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将"黑人女性最佳"框架应用于税收政策分析；2. 提出通过关注最边缘化群体的经济状况来评估整体经济公平性的理论视角；3. 为理解交叉性（种族×性别）在财富不平等中的作用提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出针对性的遗产税政策建议；2. 展示联邦和州级遗产税在缩小种族财富差距中的潜力；3. 为政策制定者提供基于数据的决策依据；4. 指出州级立法和司法裁决为遗产税改革提供了可行路径。

title: Miscoordination under Sample-based Learning
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur and Bar Ilan University

detail.title: Miscoordination under Sample-based Learning
detail.abstract: Coordination games admit two types of equilibria: pure equilibria, in which players coordinate, and mixed equilibria, in which miscoordination occurs with positive probability. We study the best experienced payoff dynamics, in which new agents sample each action k times against newly drawn opponents and then select the action with the highest average payoff. For symmetric two-action coordination games, we show that only pure equilibria are stable when (1) each player always prefers her opponent to match her own action, and (2) all agents use the same sample size, k ≥ 2. We show that relaxing either condition can generate stable miscoordination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究协调博弈中的均衡稳定性，发现当玩家总是偏好对手匹配自己的行动且所有代理使用相同样本量k≥2时，只有纯均衡是稳定的；放松任一条件则会产生稳定的不协调。
AI.research_question: 在协调博弈中，什么条件下只有纯均衡是稳定的？什么条件下会产生稳定的不协调？
AI.motivation: 协调博弈存在纯均衡（玩家协调）和混合均衡（不协调发生），需要理解在何种动态过程中这些均衡能够保持稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调博弈理论、最佳经验收益动态、演化博弈论、均衡稳定性分析
AI.method: 采用最佳经验收益动态模型，新代理对每个行动采样k次对抗新对手，然后选择平均收益最高的行动；分析对称双行动协调博弈的稳定性条件
AI.findings: 当(1)每个玩家总是偏好对手匹配自己的行动，且(2)所有代理使用相同样本量k≥2时，只有纯均衡是稳定的；放松任一条件（偏好结构或样本量一致性）都会产生稳定的不协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了协调博弈中纯均衡稳定性的精确条件，揭示了偏好结构和样本量一致性对均衡稳定性的关键作用，扩展了对协调博弈动态稳定性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计协调机制提供了理论指导，帮助理解在何种条件下系统会趋向协调或保持不协调，对组织协调、市场设计等有应用价值。

title: The Obligation to Prevent Transboundary Cyber Harm: Expand the Regulatory Regime or Continue Deflecting Responsibility
affiliations: Loyola Law School Los Angeles, Students

detail.title: The Obligation to Prevent Transboundary Cyber Harm: Expand the Regulatory Regime or Continue Deflecting Responsibility

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Dafina Bucaj, The Obligation to Prevent Transboundary
Cyber Harm: Expand the Regulatory Regime or Continue Deflecting
Responsibility, 54 Geo. Wash. Int’l L. Rev. 2 (2023). Available at
https://www.thegwilr.org/s/Bucaj-Article-542.pdf

detail.abstract: The increased ability of States and non-state actors to cause transboundary harm through cyberspace has been accompanied by a slow process of enforcement of norms of international law and a lot of contradiction regarding their applicability. Though States have increased their efforts to protect their citizens and infrastructure from being subject to malicious attacks, they have not shown the same commitment towards preventing similar activities arising from their own territories. On the contrary, it is not uncommon for States to take advantage of the difficulties of attributing activities in cyberspace and mount cyberattacks by using non-state actors as proxies. This Article explores the question of the international legal responsibility of States for harmful activities of non-state actors in cyberspace. In particular, it focuses on States’ duty to prevent cyberattacks launched by non-state actors from their territory against infrastructures in other States. While there are several aspects concerning cybersecurity and the applicable legal framework that have drawn the attention of scholars, this Article focuses primarily on the application of the general international law principle sic utere tuo ut alienum non laedas (meaning “use your own property in such a manner as not to injure that of another”) to activities in cyberspace. Positively, it argues that prevention of cyberattacks from one State’s territory is obligatory as a matter of international law. This Article argues that prevention, as opposed to management of the consequences of cyberattacks, is in States’ best interest.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国家对于源自其领土的非国家行为体网络攻击的国际法律责任，特别是预防义务，主张预防优于事后管理。
AI.research_question: 国家对于源自其领土的非国家行为体网络攻击应承担何种国际法律责任？特别是国家是否有义务预防此类攻击？
AI.motivation: 随着国家和非国家行为体通过网络空间造成跨境损害的能力增强，国际法规范的执行缓慢且适用性存在矛盾。国家在保护本国公民和基础设施免受恶意攻击方面增加了努力，但在防止源自其领土的类似活动方面缺乏同等承诺，甚至利用网络空间归因困难，通过非国家行为体作为代理人发动网络攻击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于国际法中的"sic utere tuo ut alienum non laedas"原则（使用自己的财产时不损害他人财产），将其应用于网络空间活动。
AI.method: 法律分析和理论论证，探讨国际法原则在网络空间的适用性。
AI.findings: 预防源自一国领土的网络攻击是国际法上的义务，预防比管理网络攻击后果更符合国家利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统的"sic utere tuo ut alienum non laedas"原则扩展到网络空间，为网络攻击的国家责任提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家制定网络空间行为规范提供法律依据，强调预防义务的重要性，促进国际网络安全合作。

title: Generative AI and Investor Processing of Financial Media
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Accounting, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology - Department of Accounting, Harvard University - Business School (HBS) and SC Johnson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Generative AI and Investor Processing of Financial Media

publicationDetails.journalName: Cornell Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how AI-generated summaries in financial news influence investor information processing. Exploiting The Wall Street Journal's rollout of AI summaries, we find that articles featuring these summaries elicit stronger immediate market reactions, including higher trading volume and amplified price responses. Additional analyses show that the increased trading is concentrated in the content summarized by AI, but not in the content not summarized by AI. We investigate the underlying mechanism using a controlled experiment. Contrary to the concern that AI summaries encourage skimming, we find they increase both perceived confidence and objective recall of the full article text. These findings suggest that AI summaries do not substitute for reading but rather serve as interpretive cues, enhancing overall comprehension while directing investor attention toward highlighted elements. Cross-sectional analyses show that the effects of AIgenerated summaries are strongest in settings with greater information frictions. Finally, articles with AI-generated summaries are associated with significantly greater subsequent information search by both retail and institutional investors. Overall, our study documents how the integration of AI in financial media reshapes the consumption of firm news.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI生成的财经新闻摘要如何影响投资者信息处理。研究发现AI摘要增强了市场即时反应，提高了交易量和价格响应，但交易增加主要集中在AI摘要覆盖的内容上。实验表明AI摘要并未替代全文阅读，而是作为解释性线索，提升整体理解并引导投资者关注重点内容。
AI.research_question: AI生成的财经新闻摘要如何影响投资者的信息处理和市场反应？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在新闻媒体中的广泛应用，特别是财经新闻领域，需要了解AI生成的摘要如何改变投资者获取和处理信息的方式，以及这对市场效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理理论、注意力分配理论、行为金融学中的有限注意力假设、信息摩擦理论
AI.method: 1. 利用《华尔街日报》推出AI摘要的自然实验进行实证分析；2. 控制实验检验机制；3. 横截面分析考察不同信息摩擦环境下的效应差异
AI.findings: 1. 包含AI摘要的文章引发更强的即时市场反应（交易量和价格响应增加）；2. 交易增加集中在AI摘要覆盖的内容上；3. AI摘要提升投资者的感知信心和客观回忆能力；4. 效应在信息摩擦较大的环境中最强；5. AI摘要文章引发更多后续信息搜索
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了AI摘要会鼓励"略读"的担忧，提出AI摘要作为"解释性线索"的新理论框架；2. 深化了对有限注意力下信息处理机制的理解；3. 扩展了信息摩擦理论在AI环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为财经媒体采用AI摘要提供实证依据；2. 帮助投资者理解AI摘要的认知效应；3. 为监管机构评估AI在金融信息传播中的影响提供参考；4. 为企业沟通策略提供启示

title: A Comprehensive Review of the Earned Income Tax Credit's Impacts on Labor Force Participation, Poverty Reduction, and Employment Outcomes
affiliations: Capella University

detail.title: A Comprehensive Review of the Earned Income Tax Credit's Impacts on Labor Force Participation, Poverty Reduction, and Employment Outcomes

keywords: no data used Funding information: No funding Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)

detail.abstract: This comprehensive review examines the impact of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) on various employment outcomes, including labor force participation, hours worked, job retention, and its broader economic and social implications. The EITC, a cornerstone of U.S. anti-poverty policy, has been particularly effective in increasing labor force participation among low-income workers, especially single mothers. However, its effects on other employment outcomes, such as hours worked and job retention, are more nuanced and vary across different demographic groups and income levels. This review also explores the role of state-level EITC programs, the challenges posed by the EITC's phase-out structure, and the potential unintended consequences, such as wage suppression and work disincentives. Furthermore, the review considers the expansion of the EITC to childless workers and draws on international comparisons to provide insights into potential reforms. The findings underscore the need for continued policy refinements to maximize the EITC's effectiveness in reducing poverty and promoting employment. Recommendations include redesigning the phase-out structure, expanding the credit for childless workers, integrating the EITC with other social programs, and addressing potential wage suppression. The review concludes with a discussion on the long-term impacts of the EITC and the need to adapt the program for the evolving labor market, particularly in light of the rise of the gig economy and nontraditional work arrangements.

AI.tldr: 本文全面回顾了美国劳动所得税抵免（EITC）对就业结果的影响，发现EITC能有效提高低收入工人（尤其是单亲母亲）的劳动参与率，但对工作时长、工作保留等影响较为复杂，需政策调整以最大化减贫和促进就业效果。
AI.research_question: 劳动所得税抵免（EITC）如何影响就业结果（包括劳动参与率、工作时长、工作保留）及其经济和社会影响？
AI.motivation: EITC是美国反贫困政策的核心工具，但其对不同就业结果的影响尚不完全清楚，需要系统评估以指导政策优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动供给理论、福利政策效应理论、收入激励理论，分析税收抵免对就业行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理现有关于EITC对就业影响的研究成果，包括实证研究和政策评估。
AI.findings: 1. EITC显著提高低收入工人（尤其是单亲母亲）的劳动参与率；2. 对工作时长和工作保留的影响因人口群体和收入水平而异；3. 州级EITC项目、抵免逐步取消结构、潜在工资抑制和就业抑制等挑战存在；4. 国际比较为改革提供参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税收抵免政策影响劳动供给的理论理解，特别是对不同就业结果的差异化影响机制，为福利政策设计提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议：重新设计抵免逐步取消结构、扩大无子女工人的抵免额度、将EITC与其他社会项目整合、解决潜在工资抑制问题，并适应零工经济和非传统工作安排。

title: Pantheon Authority Encoding Risk (AER) A Measurable Actuarial Variable for AI-Influenced Environments
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Pantheon Authority Encoding Risk (AER) A Measurable Actuarial Variable for AI-Influenced Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Pantheon Holdings Group, which develops governance and authority infrastructure concepts discussed in this paper. This manuscript is a theoretical and conceptual contribution intended to advance discussion regarding risk modeling and institutional accountability in AI-influenced environments.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, clinical data, or experimental subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author. No external financial support was received.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Authority Encoding Risk (AER), a structural actuarial variable designed to quantify ambiguity in decision authority within AI-influenced environments. Traditional underwriting frameworks model cyber exposure, compliance risk, and operational failure, yet lack a measurable construct for authority diffusion at the moment of system action. AER defines and formalizes authority clarity, refusal enforceability, and decision custody as quantifiable components influencing loss severity, regulatory exposure, and litigation probability. The paper proposes a measurable schema, pricing logic, and infrastructure framework for reducing actuarial volatility through encoded authority trails. The objective is to enable insurers to model, price, and mitigate structural decision ambiguity before loss events occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权威编码风险(AER)"这一结构性精算变量，用于量化AI影响环境中决策权威的模糊性。传统核保框架缺乏对系统行动时权威扩散的可测量构建，AER通过定义权威清晰度、拒绝可执行性和决策保管等可量化组件，为保险公司提供建模、定价和缓解结构性决策模糊性的框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI影响环境中量化决策权威的模糊性，并将其纳入精算模型以降低风险波动？
AI.motivation: 传统核保框架虽然能建模网络风险、合规风险和操作失败，但缺乏对系统行动时刻权威扩散的可测量构建，导致保险公司难以在损失发生前有效建模和定价结构性决策模糊性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权威理论、决策理论和精算科学，构建了权威清晰度、拒绝可执行性和决策保管三个核心概念的理论框架，将结构性决策模糊性转化为可量化的精算变量。
AI.method: 提出可测量的模式、定价逻辑和基础设施框架，通过编码权威轨迹来减少精算波动性，包括定义AER变量、制定量化组件和建立实施框架。
AI.findings: AER能够有效量化AI环境中决策权威的模糊性，为保险公司提供建模、定价和缓解结构性决策模糊性的工具，从而在损失发生前降低风险暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次提出"权威编码风险"这一结构性精算变量概念；2) 建立了权威清晰度、拒绝可执行性和决策保管的理论框架；3) 将决策权威模糊性从定性概念转化为可量化变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为保险公司提供可操作的AER测量模式；2) 开发了基于AER的定价逻辑；3) 建立了减少精算波动性的基础设施框架；4) 使保险公司能够在损失发生前建模和缓解决策权威模糊性。

title: Consumption as Civic Power: How Distributed Choice Shapes Markets and Reclaims Economic Agency
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Consumption as Civic Power: How Distributed Choice Shapes Markets and Reclaims Economic Agency
detail.abstract: People do not merely buy products. Every act of consumption is a choice that reallocates resources, reinforces business models, and reshapes market structure. In aggregate, dispersed consumer decisions determine which firms grow, which industries dominate, and which values become embedded in everyday economic life. Yet under modern capitalism, this distributed power is often exercised unconsciously and captured by corporate influencethrough branding, advertising, and behavioral manipulationleading individuals to " vote " for exploitative structures without recognizing that they are voting at all. This paper argues that inequality persists not only because capital is concentrated, but because the political nature of consumption remains socially unrecognized. Reclaiming economic agency begins with a conceptual shift: consumption is a world-shaping vote. When consumers become aware of this power and use it deliberately, corporate power becomes structurally dependent on serving human interests rather than extracting from them.

AI.tldr: 本文认为消费具有政治性，但消费者往往意识不到自己的消费选择是在"投票"塑造经济结构。不平等持续存在不仅因为资本集中，更因为消费的政治性质未被社会认识。当消费者意识到并有意运用这种"投票权"时，企业权力将转变为服务于人类利益而非剥削。
AI.research_question: 为什么在现代资本主义中，不平等会持续存在？消费选择如何影响市场结构和企业权力？消费者如何能够重新获得经济代理权？
AI.motivation: 消费不仅是个人购买行为，而是具有政治意义的集体决策过程。然而，消费者往往无意识地通过消费选择支持了剥削性结构，因为企业通过品牌、广告和行为操纵等手段捕获了这种分散的权力。需要揭示消费的政治本质，帮助消费者重新获得经济代理权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费政治理论、经济代理理论、企业权力理论、市场结构理论、行为经济学中的消费者操纵理论
AI.method: 概念分析、理论建构、批判性分析
AI.findings: 1. 消费选择具有政治性质，是资源再分配、商业模式强化和市场结构重塑的过程；2. 消费者分散的决策权往往被企业通过品牌和广告等手段捕获；3. 不平等持续存在不仅因为资本集中，更因为消费的政治性质未被社会认识；4. 当消费者意识到并有意运用消费"投票权"时，企业权力结构将发生转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"消费即投票"的概念框架，将消费重新概念化为政治行为；2. 发展了消费政治理论，解释不平等持续存在的机制；3. 构建了经济代理权重新获得的理论路径；4. 拓展了企业权力与消费者关系的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提高消费者对消费选择政治意义的认识；2. 为消费者运动和社会运动提供理论支持；3. 为企业社会责任和可持续发展提供新的视角；4. 为政策制定者设计促进负责任消费的政策提供理论基础。

title: Financial Instability and Bank Competition in Interwar France
affiliations: Ecole Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay

detail.title: Financial Instability and Bank Competition in Interwar France
detail.abstract: The French interwar period, a regulation-free banking environment, was marked by a Great Expansion of branch networks (Bonhoure et al., 2024), which substantially increased banking outreach and intensified local competition across the country. This expansion was accompanied by a rise in branch closures, peaking during the Great Depression. This paper asks whether heightened local banking competition contributed to this greater financial instability. While the literature offers mixed conclusions on the relationship between bank competition and financial stability, branch survival analysis from this study supports the competition-fragility mechanism: in normal times, higher local competition significantly increases the instantaneous probability of branch closure, all else equal. This finding is robust to a wide set of branch-, bank-, and city-level controls, as well as to the inclusion of time trends. However, local competition does not account for the spatial distribution of closures during the crisis. Interestingly, branches' temporary status matters even more: permanent branches, which operate at higher fixed cost, tend to survive for a shorter duration.

AI.tldr: 法国两次世界大战间的无监管银行环境经历了分行网络的大扩张，但伴随而来的是分行关闭潮。研究发现，在正常时期，更高的本地银行竞争显著增加了分行关闭的概率，支持"竞争-脆弱性"机制，但竞争无法解释危机期间关闭的空间分布。永久性分行因固定成本更高，生存时间反而更短。
AI.research_question: 本地银行竞争的加剧是否导致了法国两次世界大战间时期更大的金融不稳定性？
AI.motivation: 法国两次世界大战间的无监管银行环境经历了分行网络的大扩张（Great Expansion），这大幅增加了银行覆盖范围并加剧了全国范围内的本地竞争。这种扩张伴随着分行关闭的增加，在大萧条期间达到顶峰。现有文献对银行竞争与金融稳定性的关系存在矛盾结论，因此需要实证研究这一时期的具体情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于"竞争-脆弱性"理论框架，探讨银行竞争与金融稳定性之间的关系。文献中对此存在混合结论，本文旨在通过历史案例检验这一理论机制。
AI.method: 采用分行生存分析（branch survival analysis），控制分行层面、银行层面和城市层面的多种变量，并考虑时间趋势的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 在正常时期，更高的本地竞争显著增加了分行关闭的瞬时概率，支持"竞争-脆弱性"机制；2. 这一发现在广泛的变量控制和时间趋势下保持稳健；3. 然而，本地竞争无法解释危机期间关闭的空间分布；4. 有趣的是，分行的临时性状态更重要：永久性分行因运营固定成本更高，生存时间反而更短。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"竞争-脆弱性"理论提供了历史实证支持，特别是在无监管银行环境下的证据。揭示了分行类型（临时vs永久）对生存概率的重要影响，丰富了银行竞争与稳定性关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对银行监管政策有启示：在促进银行竞争的同时需要考虑其对金融稳定的潜在影响。对银行管理者而言，需要权衡分行网络扩张策略与运营成本结构，特别是永久性分行的风险。

title: Probabilistic and Statistical Models for Evaluating Accuracy, Reliability, and Speed in Biathlon Shooting
affiliations: Stanford

detail.title: Probabilistic and Statistical Models for Evaluating Accuracy, Reliability, and Speed in Biathlon Shooting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

contentType.other: General information for athletes and coaches

detail.abstract:
This slide deck presents a practical, statistics-based framework for evaluating and improving biathlon shooting performance for athletes and coaches. Rather than focusing only on average hit rate, it separates three complementary targets: accuracy (hit probability), reliability (accuracy fluctuations), and precision (shot dispersion).

Accuracy is modeled with Binomial and Beta–Binomial distributions, where the Beta–Binomial captures overdispersion effects on reliability. Precision is modeled using a Rayleigh distribution, linking group size on paper targets to hit probability and providing a position mechanics metric that complements hits/misses. The deck also introduces BASE (Biathlon Adjusted Shooting Evaluation), a simple performance metric that combines shooting time and miss penalties into a single, cohort-benchmarked score.

Together, these tools support clearer diagnosis (mechanics vs. decision/wind vs. volatility), more meaningful tracking over time, and training choices aimed at reducing avoidable variance while improving performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于统计的实用框架，用于评估和改进冬季两项射击表现，将表现分解为准确性、可靠性和精确度三个维度，并引入BASE评分系统。
AI.research_question: 如何建立科学的统计框架来全面评估和改进冬季两项射击表现，超越简单的命中率分析？
AI.motivation: 传统冬季两项射击评估过于依赖平均命中率，无法区分表现的不同维度（准确性、可靠性、精确度），限制了运动员和教练的诊断和改进能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于统计学理论：二项分布和Beta-二项分布建模准确性（考虑过度离散效应），瑞利分布建模精确度（射击散布），综合评估框架。
AI.method: 统计建模方法：使用二项分布和Beta-二项分布分析命中概率和可靠性波动，瑞利分布分析射击散布，开发BASE评分系统整合射击时间和脱靶惩罚。
AI.findings: 建立了能够区分射击表现三个维度的统计框架：准确性（命中概率）、可靠性（波动性）、精确度（散布），并开发了基准化的综合评分系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：将冬季两项射击表现分解为三个统计维度，建立了相应的概率分布模型，提供了更精细的表现评估理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为运动员和教练提供实用的诊断工具（区分技术问题、决策/风力影响、波动性），支持训练决策和长期跟踪，引入BASE评分系统进行基准比较。

title: A Unified Analytical Framework for Classical Theories of Economic Growth
affiliations: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, University of Rome "La Sapienza" and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: A Unified Analytical Framework for Classical Theories of Economic Growth

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 12/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article develops a discrete-time model of economic growth inspired by classical thought, which unifies within a single formal framework the fundamental insights of Adam Smith, David Ricardo, and Thomas Robert Malthus. On the analytical level, the model allows for: (i) deriving a compact relationship between the output growth rate and the effective net profit rate, as well as an economic relevance condition that precludes degenerate trajectories; (ii) characterizing the distribution of income between profits and rents as a function of technological parameters (labor productivity, land-labor ratio, unit rent), highlighting the role of the reinvested profit share; (iii) specifying three variants-Smithian, Ricardian, and Malthusian-obtained solely by modifying the rule governing labor productivity formation and/or population dynamics. The model provides a unified formal framework to represent and compare the three main classical perspectives on growth, elucidating the connection between intertemporal dynamics and income distribution through a tool suitable for both theoretical analysis and numerical simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个受古典思想启发的离散时间经济增长模型，将亚当·斯密、大卫·李嘉图和托马斯·罗伯特·马尔萨斯的基本见解统一在一个单一的形式框架内。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个统一的形式框架内整合斯密、李嘉图和马尔萨斯的主要古典经济增长观点，并分析经济增长率与有效净利润率之间的关系以及收入分配动态？
AI.motivation: 古典经济学家（斯密、李嘉图、马尔萨斯）对经济增长提出了不同的见解，但缺乏一个统一的形式框架来系统比较和分析这些观点，特别是关于经济增长与收入分配之间的动态关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古典经济学理论，特别是亚当·斯密的劳动分工和资本积累理论、大卫·李嘉图的租金理论和比较优势理论、托马斯·马尔萨斯的人口理论，构建了一个统一的离散时间经济增长模型。
AI.method: 开发了一个离散时间经济增长模型，通过数学形式化整合古典经济思想，允许推导经济增长率与净利润率的关系，分析收入分配（利润与租金）作为技术参数的函数，并通过修改劳动生产率形成规则和/或人口动态规则来获得斯密式、李嘉图式和马尔萨斯式三种变体。
AI.findings: 模型能够：(1)推导出产出增长率与有效净利润率之间的紧凑关系，以及防止退化轨迹的经济相关性条件；(2)将利润与租金之间的收入分配表征为技术参数（劳动生产率、土地-劳动比率、单位租金）的函数，突出再投资利润份额的作用；(3)通过修改劳动生产力形成规则和/或人口动态规则，获得三种古典经济增长变体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的形式框架来代表和比较三种主要的古典经济增长观点，阐明了跨期动态与收入分配之间的联系，为理论分析和数值模拟提供了合适的工具，填补了古典经济增长理论形式化整合的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模型可用于政策分析和经济预测，帮助理解不同经济政策对增长和收入分配的影响，为发展经济学和经济增长研究提供了可操作的分析工具，特别适用于模拟不同古典经济增长路径下的经济动态。

title: Market Memory Structure and the Cost of Over-Differencing in ML Forecasting
affiliations: Fordham University

detail.title: Market Memory Structure and the Cost of Over-Differencing in ML Forecasting
detail.abstract: We document two findings using 464 S&P 500 constituents over 2010-2025. First, the cost of differencing error is sharply asymmetric for modern machine learning: over-differencing irreversibly destroys predictive autocorrelation structure, while mild under-differencing is harmless because modern ML models are sufficiently flexible to learn through residual non-stationarity. Full differencing (d = 1)-the textbook prescription-produces out-of-sample forecast correlations indistinguishable from a coin flip across all memory regimes. Second, the walkforward detectability boundary d LTM , estimated via the finite-sample procedure of Bhatti (2026), reveals genuine and coherent structure in how equity return-generating processes store information-structure that varies meaningfully across tickers, across memory regimes, and through macroeconomic time. The theoretical foundation and estimation methodology behind d LTM are developed in Bhatti (2026); this paper concerns only what that estimator reveals about equity market structure.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：1）现代机器学习中差分误差成本严重不对称——过度差分不可逆地破坏预测自相关结构，而轻微欠差分无害；2）通过Bhatti(2026)方法估计的游走可检测边界d_LTM揭示了股票收益生成过程存储信息的真实结构，该结构在不同股票、记忆机制和宏观经济时期存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 现代机器学习在股票收益预测中，差分处理对预测性能的影响是什么？股票收益生成过程的信息存储结构如何通过游走可检测边界d_LTM来揭示？
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列分析中，完全差分(d=1)是标准做法，但现代机器学习模型具有不同的特性。需要研究差分处理对ML预测性能的影响，并探索股票市场信息存储结构的新度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）差分误差成本不对称理论；2）游走可检测边界理论（基于Bhatti 2026）；3）现代机器学习模型灵活性理论；4）股票收益生成过程的信息存储结构理论
AI.method: 使用464只S&P 500成分股2010-2025年数据，比较不同差分程度下的预测性能。采用Bhatti(2026)的有限样本程序估计游走可检测边界d_LTM，分析其在不同股票、记忆机制和宏观经济时期的变化。
AI.findings: 1）过度差分不可逆地破坏预测自相关结构，而轻微欠差分无害；2）完全差分(d=1)的样本外预测相关性在所有记忆机制下与随机猜测无异；3）d_LTM揭示了股票收益生成过程存储信息的真实结构，该结构存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出差分误差成本不对称理论；2）将游走可检测边界理论应用于股票市场结构分析；3）挑战传统时间序列分析中完全差分的标准做法；4）为现代机器学习在金融时间序列预测中的应用提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融从业者提供差分处理的最佳实践指导；2）d_LTM可作为股票市场信息结构的新诊断工具；3）帮助投资者理解不同股票的信息存储特性；4）为机器学习在金融预测中的实际应用提供具体建议。

title: Infrastructure Investment and Its Economic Impact on Labour Markets: A Complex Analysis

detail.title: Infrastructure Investment and Its Economic Impact on Labour Markets: A Complex Analysis
detail.abstract: This thesis, Unravelling the Complexity of Infrastructure Investment and Economic Impact in the Labour Market, explores the intricate dynamics between large-scale infrastructure projects and labour market transformations, with a specific focus on the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) as a case study. The research employs an empirical analysis, drawing on data collected over multiple years, to examine the direct and indirect effects of infrastructure investment on labour movement, employment patterns, and sectoral shifts within Pakistan. By comparing various economic models, this thesis reveals the divergent outcomes across growth trajectories, highlighting the differential impacts on wage structures, employment mobility, and sectoral redistributions as CPEC-related projects materialise. The findings contribute to a deeper understanding of how infrastructure-led growth reshapes labour markets, offering insights into the long-term economic implications of such large-scale investments for both developing and emerging economies. Through a nuanced examination of these effects, this study underscores the complexities of infrastructure's role in fostering sustainable, inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究以中巴经济走廊为案例，通过实证分析探讨大规模基础设施投资对劳动力市场的复杂影响，包括劳动力流动、就业模式和部门转移等直接和间接效应。
AI.research_question: 大规模基础设施投资（特别是中巴经济走廊项目）如何影响劳动力市场的转型，包括劳动力流动、就业模式和部门转移？
AI.motivation: 理解基础设施投资与劳动力市场动态之间的复杂关系，特别是对于发展中国家和新兴经济体，以评估大型基础设施项目对可持续包容性增长的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施投资与经济增长理论、劳动力市场转型理论、部门转移理论、就业流动性和工资结构理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，基于多年收集的数据，比较不同经济模型，研究中巴经济走廊相关项目的直接和间接影响。
AI.findings: 基础设施投资在不同增长轨迹下产生不同结果，对工资结构、就业流动性和部门再分配产生差异影响，揭示了基础设施驱动增长重塑劳动力市场的复杂机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对基础设施驱动增长如何重塑劳动力市场的理论理解，揭示了基础设施在促进可持续包容性增长中的复杂作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和新兴经济体的大规模基础设施投资提供政策启示，帮助理解长期经济影响，促进更有效的劳动力市场政策制定。

title: The Inflation Penalty and Optimal Annuitisation Timing: Evidence from India's National Pension System
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd

detail.title: The Inflation Penalty and Optimal Annuitisation Timing: Evidence from India's National Pension System
detail.abstract: We solve a continuous-time optimal-stopping problem for a retiree choosing when to convert liquid wealth into a nominal life annuity under stochastic inflation and Indian mortality. Under the baseline calibrations-CPI inflation averaging 6.65% with 3.14% volatility, IIAM 2012-15 mortality, and October 2025 annuity quotes-the optimal policy is a corner solution: no finite wealth threshold triggers voluntary annuitisation at any age between 60 and 75. The mechanism is an inflation penalty Ξ ≈ 10%, several times larger than the values typically reported in developedmarket calibrations. We introduce the welfare-equivalent money's-worth ratio (WE-MWR *), which separates the actuarial load from the inflation penalty: at near-zero inflation, annuitisation is welfare-improving despite a 22% load; India's inflation reverses this, requiring payouts 45-85% above market rates for welfare neutrality. A rationality threshold at π * ≈ 3.5% implies that the Reserve Bank of India's 4% CPI target sits at the knife-edge of annuitisation rationality.

AI.tldr: 该研究解决了在随机通胀和印度死亡率下退休人员何时将流动性财富转换为名义年金的最优停止问题。研究发现，在印度高通胀环境下，最优策略是永不自愿年金化，因为通胀惩罚（约10%）远高于发达国家水平。研究提出了福利等价货币价值比率，发现在零通胀时年金化仍有福利改善，但印度通胀需要支付高出市场利率45-85%才能使福利中性。印度央行4%的通胀目标正处于年金化合理性的临界点。
AI.research_question: 在随机通胀和印度死亡率条件下，退休人员何时应该将流动性财富转换为名义年金是最优的？
AI.motivation: 印度面临高通胀环境（平均6.65%通胀率），这对年金决策产生重要影响。现有研究主要基于发达国家低通胀环境，需要研究高通胀新兴市场下的最优年金化策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间最优停止理论、随机通胀模型、印度死亡率模型（IIAM 2012-15）、福利经济学框架
AI.method: 连续时间最优停止问题建模，使用印度CPI通胀数据（平均6.65%，波动率3.14%）、印度死亡率表、2025年10月年金报价进行基准校准
AI.findings:
1. 最优策略是角点解：在任何年龄（60-75岁）都没有有限的财富阈值触发自愿年金化
2. 通胀惩罚Ξ≈10%，是发达国家校准值的数倍
3. 在接近零通胀时，即使有22%的附加费，年金化仍能改善福利
4. 印度通胀环境下，需要支付高出市场利率45-85%才能使福利中性
5. 合理性阈值π*≈3.5%，印度央行4%的CPI目标处于临界点
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了福利等价货币价值比率（WE-MWR*），将精算附加费与通胀惩罚分离
2. 建立了高通胀新兴市场下的年金决策理论框架
3. 识别了通胀对年金化决策的关键影响机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为印度退休人员提供了年金决策指导：在当前通胀环境下不应自愿年金化
2. 为印度央行政策制定提供依据：4%通胀目标处于年金化合理性的临界点
3. 为年金产品设计者提供参考：需要大幅提高支付率才能在高通胀环境下保持吸引力
4. 为其他高通胀新兴市场的年金政策提供借鉴

title: Menstrual Stigma and Human Capital: Experimental Evidence from Madagascar
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE), affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Menstrual Stigma and Human Capital: Experimental Evidence from Madagascar
detail.abstract: Menstrual stigma affects adolescent girls worldwide, yet its impact on human capital development remains largely unexamined. We use a field experiment in 140 schools in Madagascar to evaluate interventions designed to reduce menstrual stigma and promote hygiene behaviors (N =2,250). Teacher-led sensitization on stigma and hygiene, menstrual products, and sanitation infrastructure together substantially improve girls' learning outcomes on standardized tests (+0.2 SD). These gains do not operate by improving school attendance or health, the channels typically invoked to justify menstrual hygiene programs. Instead, the improvements appear to arise from psychosocial mechanisms, including reduced menstrual stigma (measured using lab-in-the-field exercises, enumerator observations, and self-reports) and reduced stress (lower heart rate). We also test a novel approach for norm change by identifying "positive deviants"-girls within schools willing to openly challenge menstrual stigma. Selecting and training these positive deviants to serve as peer ambassadors for norm change produces significant additional improvements in self-reported stigma and hygiene behavior. The results demonstrate that addressing gender-specific psychosocial barriers can substantially improve girls' education outcomes in highly deprived contexts, while highlighting both the promise and limitations of leveraging positive deviance for social norm change.

AI.tldr: 在140所马达加斯加学校进行的实地实验发现，通过教师主导的月经污名化教育和卫生干预，结合月经产品和卫生设施改善，能显著提高女生的学习成绩（+0.2标准差）。这些改善并非通过提高出勤率或健康状况，而是通过减少月经污名化和心理压力等心理社会机制实现的。研究还测试了"积极偏差者"作为同伴大使促进规范改变的新方法。
AI.research_question: 月经污名化如何影响青春期女生的人力资本发展？哪些干预措施能有效减少月经污名化并改善女生的教育成果？
AI.motivation: 月经污名化影响全球青春期女生，但其对人力资本发展的影响尚未得到充分研究。现有月经卫生项目通常关注出勤率和健康改善，但可能忽略了心理社会机制的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 社会规范理论：月经污名化作为社会规范对女生教育的影响；2) 心理社会障碍理论：污名化如何通过心理机制影响学习表现；3) 积极偏差者理论：利用愿意挑战现有规范的个体推动社会变革。
AI.method: 在140所马达加斯加学校进行的随机对照实验（N=2,250），包括教师主导的污名化教育和卫生干预、提供月经产品、改善卫生设施。使用实验室实地测量、观察员观察和自我报告测量污名化，测量心率评估压力水平，标准化测试评估学习成果。
AI.findings: 综合干预显著提高女生标准化测试成绩（+0.2标准差）。改善机制不是通过提高出勤率或健康状况，而是通过减少月经污名化和降低心理压力。积极偏差者作为同伴大使能进一步改善自我报告的污名化态度和卫生行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别月经污名化作为影响女生教育的重要心理社会障碍；2) 挑战传统月经卫生项目主要关注出勤率和健康的假设；3) 验证积极偏差者方法在促进社会规范改变中的潜力和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为教育政策制定者提供基于证据的干预方案；2) 展示综合干预（教育+产品+设施）的有效性；3) 提供利用积极偏差者促进规范改变的实施策略；4) 强调在高度贫困环境中解决性别特定心理社会障碍的重要性。

title: Product Testing in Markets for Experience Goods
affiliations: Institute for Advanced Studies, Wissenschaftszentrum Berlin für Sozialforschung (WZB) and University of Vienna

detail.title: Product Testing in Markets for Experience Goods
detail.abstract: In markets for experience goods where sellers cannot build reputations, buyers may refrain from purchasing, leading to low efficiency. A product testing institution can mitigate this problem by offering buyers a noisy but informative signal about product quality for a fee before they decide whether to buy. Theory predicts that such testing improves efficiency only when the signal is inexpensive; if the cost is high, it should have no effect. Our experimental results confirm that low-cost signals increase efficiency, although the gains are smaller than expected. Surprisingly, high-cost signals also improve efficiency compared to a control treatment without signals. These findings suggest that institutions predicted to be ineffective by standard theory may nevertheless perform better in practice.

AI.tldr: 实验研究发现，在经验品市场中，即使高成本的第三方质量检测信号也能提高市场效率，这与标准理论预测相悖。
AI.research_question: 第三方质量检测机构提供的信号成本如何影响经验品市场的效率？高成本信号是否真的如理论预测那样无效？
AI.motivation: 在卖方无法建立声誉的经验品市场中，买方可能因信息不对称而拒绝购买，导致市场效率低下。第三方检测机构可以提供质量信号，但标准理论预测只有低成本信号才能改善效率，而高成本信号无效。需要实证检验这一理论预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经验品市场理论、信息不对称理论、信号理论、第三方认证机制
AI.method: 实验经济学方法，设置控制组（无信号）、低成本信号组和高成本信号组，比较不同条件下的市场效率
AI.findings: 1. 低成本信号确实提高了市场效率，但提升幅度小于理论预期；2. 令人惊讶的是，高成本信号也显著提高了效率，优于无信号的控制组；3. 标准理论预测高成本信号无效，但实验结果显示其在实际中仍有效
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了标准理论关于高成本信号无效的预测，表明实际市场行为与理论模型存在差异，为第三方认证机制的有效性提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场监管机构提供了实证依据：即使检测成本较高，第三方质量检测仍能改善市场效率，支持在经验品市场中推广第三方认证机制

title: SUM3API: Using Rust, ZeroMQ, and MetaQuotes Language (MQL5) API Combination to Extract, Communicate, and Externally Project Financial Data from MetaTrader 5 (MT5)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: SUM3API: Using Rust, ZeroMQ, and MetaQuotes Language (MQL5) API Combination to Extract, Communicate, and Externally Project Financial Data from MetaTrader 5 (MT5)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper. The research was conducted independently and without any commercial, financial, or institutional affiliations that could be perceived as influencing the results. The author has no financial relationship with MetaQuotes Ltd., brokerage institutions, or contributors to the ZeroMQ or Rust ecosystems that would constitute a competing interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, patient data, surveys, interviews, or personally identifiable information. The research is limited to software architecture design, system integration, and financial market data processing within an authenticated MetaTrader 5 environment. As such, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was independently conceived, developed, and completed by the author.

detail.abstract: MetaTrader 5 (MT5), developed by MetaQuotes Ltd., is one of the most widely adopted multi-asset retail trading platforms, supporting automated algorithmic trading through Expert Advisors (EAs) written in MetaQuotes Language 5 (MQL5). Although MetaQuotes provides an official Python integration package for programmatic access, publicly documented methodologies for extracting financial data from within the MT5 environment and projecting it to external applications remain limited-particularly for high-performance, memory-safe systems programming languages such as Rust. To address this gap, we present SUM3API, a novel inter-process communication (IPC) framework that bridges MQL5 and Rust via ZeroMQ publisher-subscriber (PUB/SUB) and request-reply (REQ/REP) socket bindings. The framework comprises three components: (1) a reusable MQL5 wrapper library (CZmq) that encapsulates ZeroMQ native library operations through foreign function interface (FFI) calls, (2) an Expert Advisor (ZmqPublisher.mq5) that extracts real-time tick data, account state, position information, and pending orders from the authenticated MT5 session and publishes them as JSON-serialized messages, and (3) an asynchronous Rust application built on the Tokio runtime that consumes tick streams, issues trade commands, and renders a real-time trading terminal GUI using the egui framework. A distinctive architectural advantage of this approach over the official Python API is the elimination of credential exposure: the Expert Advisor inherits the MT5 terminal's pre-authenticated session, and no account credentials are transmitted over the communication layer. We validated the methodology through integration within a functional trading terminal demonstrating realtime account monitoring (balance, equity, margin), downloadable historical data (OHLC bars and raw ticks), live tick recording, trade execution (market, limit, and stop orders), position and order management, and a microsecond-resolution raw tick-level bid/ask price formation chart. All source code is open-source and available at: https://github.com/ContinualQuasars/SUM3API.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个名为SUM3API的新型IPC框架，通过ZeroMQ连接MQL5和Rust，实现MT5交易平台与外部高性能Rust应用的无缝集成，解决了官方Python API在性能、内存安全和凭证暴露方面的限制。
AI.research_question: 如何为MetaTrader 5平台开发一个高性能、内存安全且无需凭证暴露的跨语言集成框架，以支持实时金融数据提取和交易执行？
AI.motivation: MetaTrader 5作为广泛使用的零售交易平台，其官方Python集成方案存在性能限制和凭证安全问题，且缺乏对高性能系统编程语言（如Rust）的支持，限制了高级交易系统的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于进程间通信（IPC）理论，采用ZeroMQ消息队列的发布-订阅（PUB/SUB）和请求-回复（REQ/REP）模式，结合异步编程模型和GUI框架理论。
AI.method: 开发了包含三个组件的框架：1）MQL5包装库（CZmq）通过FFI调用ZeroMQ原生库；2）专家顾问（ZmqPublisher.mq5）提取实时数据并发布JSON消息；3）基于Tokio运行时的异步Rust应用，包含GUI界面和交易功能。
AI.findings: SUM3API框架成功实现了实时账户监控、历史数据下载、实时报价记录、交易执行、头寸和订单管理等功能，并提供了微秒级精度的报价图表，相比官方Python API消除了凭证暴露风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于ZeroMQ的跨语言IPC架构模式，为金融交易系统集成提供了新的理论框架；探索了MQL5与Rust的集成方法，扩展了高性能系统编程在金融科技领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了开源实现，使开发者能够构建高性能、安全的交易系统；解决了凭证安全问题；为实时金融数据处理和交易执行提供了完整的解决方案；支持微秒级精度的时间序列分析。

title: Human-AI Collaboration in State E-Governance Systems: A Research-in-Progress Study of Usability, Trust, and Adoption in e-Office and Scholarship Portals
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Human-AI Collaboration in State E-Governance Systems: A Research-in-Progress Study of Usability, Trust, and Adoption in e-Office and Scholarship Portals
detail.abstract: State-level e-governance initiatives are increasingly adopted to modernize public administration, improve transparency, and provide faster citizen services. However, many digital government systems continue to face adoption challenges due to complex workflows, limited usability, low digital literacy, and lack of support for government staff and citizens. In India, systems such as e-Office platforms and scholarship portals have become central tools for service delivery, yet users frequently report difficulties related to navigation, document handling, authentication, and unclear status updates. Recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have introduced opportunities to enhance digital public services through chatbot assistance, automated guidance, and decision-support mechanisms. At the same time, AI integration raises concerns regarding trust, transparency, accountability, and user reliance. This paper presents a research-in-progress study proposing an empirical investigation of human-AI collaboration in state e-governance systems, focusing on two major use cases: e-Office workflows used by government employees and scholarship portals used by students/citizens. The study is grounded in the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) and examines how performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, and trust perceptions shape user adoption. A survey-based methodology is proposed to capture the experiences of both citizens and government employees. The expected contributions include identifying key usability and trust barriers, assessing readiness for AI-enabled assistance, and proposing practical design recommendations for inclusive and accountable AI adoption in local government digital services.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度州级电子政务系统中人机协作的采用挑战，基于UTAUT理论分析影响用户接受度的关键因素，并提出AI辅助系统的设计建议。
AI.research_question: 在印度州级电子政务系统中，哪些因素（包括绩效期望、努力期望、社会影响、便利条件和信任感知）影响用户对AI辅助功能的接受度？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度推行了e-Office平台和奖学金门户等数字政府系统，但复杂的流程、可用性差、数字素养低以及缺乏支持等问题导致用户采用困难。AI技术为改善公共服务提供了机会，但也引发了信任、透明度和问责制等担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一技术接受与使用理论（UTAUT），包括绩效期望、努力期望、社会影响、便利条件和信任感知等核心构念。
AI.method: 基于调查的方法论，收集公民和政府员工的体验数据，实证研究人机协作在电子政务系统中的采用情况。
AI.findings: 研究尚在进行中，预期将识别关键可用性和信任障碍，评估AI辅助功能的准备度，并提出设计建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展UTAUT理论在AI辅助电子政务系统中的应用，深化对信任因素在人机协作中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府数字服务提供包容性和负责任的AI采用设计建议，帮助改善电子政务系统的用户体验和采用率。

title: Civilizational Control Theory: Foundational Propositions A Programmatic Framework for Multi-Layer Control Systems

detail.title: Civilizational Control Theory: Foundational Propositions A Programmatic Framework for Multi-Layer Control Systems
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Civilizational Control Theory (CCT), a programmatic framework that models civilizations as open, dissipative, multi-layer control systems. CCT conceptualizes civilizational order as a stabilized non-equilibrium process maintained through information-energy regulation. We articulate ten foundational propositions concerning control bandwidth, mutual information, energy allocation gradients, spectral centralization, institutional evolution, and AI-induced compression of decision latency. These propositions reformulate civilizational dynamics as problems of stability, controllability, and adaptive feedback under entropy constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了文明控制理论(CCT)，将文明建模为开放、耗散的多层控制系统，将文明秩序概念化为通过信息-能量调节维持的稳定非平衡过程。
AI.research_question: 如何将文明动态建模为控制系统问题？文明秩序如何通过信息-能量调节在熵约束下维持稳定？
AI.motivation: 现有文明理论缺乏系统控制视角，需要新的理论框架来理解文明作为复杂系统的稳定性、可控性和适应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文明控制理论(CCT)，基于控制理论、系统理论、耗散结构理论和信息论。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，提出十个基础命题，包括控制带宽、互信息、能量分配梯度、谱集中化、制度演化、AI决策延迟压缩等概念。
AI.findings: 文明可以被建模为开放耗散控制系统，文明秩序是稳定非平衡过程，文明动态可以重新表述为稳定性、可控性和适应性反馈问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了文明控制理论(CCT)作为程序性框架，将控制理论应用于文明研究，提供了理解文明动态的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了分析文明稳定性和适应性的工具，有助于理解AI等技术对文明决策过程的影响。

title: The Citizens Executive Right (CER): Restoring Dispositional Power over Tax Revenues
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Citizens Executive Right (CER): Restoring Dispositional Power over Tax Revenues

declarations.ethicsApproval: Declaration of Interest The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This article develops a new fiscal constitutional model The Citizens Executive Right(CER)that restores the dispositional power over tax revenues to individual citizens. Building on the law-and-economics tradition of Buchanan, Tullock, and Brennan, the paper argues that the core failure of modern fiscal states lies not merely in political agency problems, but in a fundamental property-rights dislocation: citizens supply fiscal resources, yet the state monopolizes their disposition. This institutional severance generates chronic rent-seeking, budget maximization, and persistent divergence between public expenditure and citizen preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公民执行权"(CER)财政宪法模型，将税收收入的处置权归还给公民个人，以解决现代财政国家的核心问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过制度设计解决现代财政国家中公民供给财政资源但国家垄断处置权所导致的根本性产权错位问题？
AI.motivation: 现代财政国家的核心失败不仅在于政治代理问题，而在于根本的产权错位：公民供给财政资源，但国家垄断其处置权，导致寻租、预算最大化及公共支出与公民偏好持续偏离。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于布坎南、塔洛克和布伦南的法律与经济学传统，特别是财政宪法理论和公共选择理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与制度设计方法，提出新的财政宪法模型"公民执行权"(CER)。
AI.findings: 制度性割裂导致寻租、预算最大化及公共支出与公民偏好的持续偏离，需要通过将税收处置权归还给公民来解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了新的财政宪法理论模型，扩展了法律与经济学传统，提出了"公民执行权"概念，深化了对财政国家制度失败的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财政制度改革提供了具体的制度设计方案，有助于减少寻租、控制预算膨胀，使公共支出更符合公民偏好。

title: One Market, One Supervision - Rethinking the Supervisory Landscape for a Truly Integrated Capital Market in Europe
affiliations: European Central Bank, , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: One Market, One Supervision - Rethinking the Supervisory Landscape for a Truly Integrated Capital Market in Europe
detail.abstract: This paper provides an evidence-based assessment of the EU supervisory landscape by combining a comprehensive mapping of supervisory models and authorities with an analysis of capital market players across key sectors, including market infrastructures, asset management, and crypto-asset service providers. It documents a highly complex and fragmented supervisory architecture, characterised by a wide variety of national supervisory models and multiple authorities operating across the Union. While regulatory harmonisation through the Single Rulebook has progressed, supervisory responsibilities for capital market players remain largely national, with limited and uneven EU-level powers. This institutional fragmentation is increasingly misaligned with market realities, as capital markets have become more cross-border and integrated, albeit with important differences across sectors. The paper develops an analytical framework to assess options for a review of the EU capital markets supervisory architecture. Based on the sectoral mapping, it distils a few guiding principles for supervisory integration: a consistent approach based on common criteria (such as size and cross-border relevance) while accounting for sectoral specificities, and close cooperation between EU and national authorities. Finally, it conducts a sensitivity analysis around alternative degrees of supervisory integration and calibration criteria, and discusses the governance arrangements needed to make integrated supervision effective in practice. The analysis shows that a more integrated supervisory framework could deliver four key benefits: enhanced supervisory effectiveness, improved supervisory efficiency, reduced complexity and compliance burdens for firms operating across jurisdictions, and the removal of supervisory barriers that currently hinder the cross-border integration of EU capital markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全面分析欧盟资本市场监管架构，发现其高度复杂且碎片化，与日益跨境整合的市场现实不匹配。论文提出了评估监管架构改革选项的分析框架，并论证了更一体化监管框架的四大益处。
AI.research_question: 欧盟资本市场监管架构应如何改革以更好地适应跨境整合的市场现实？
AI.motivation: 欧盟资本市场监管架构高度复杂且碎片化，虽然通过单一规则手册实现了监管协调，但监管责任仍主要在国家层面，与日益跨境整合的市场现实不匹配，需要系统性评估改革选项。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管架构分析框架、一体化监管理论、跨境监管协调理论
AI.method: 1. 全面映射欧盟监管模式和监管机构；2. 分析关键行业（市场基础设施、资产管理、加密资产服务提供商）的市场参与者；3. 开发评估监管架构改革选项的分析框架；4. 进行敏感性分析，探讨不同监管一体化程度和校准标准；5. 讨论有效一体化监管所需的治理安排
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟监管架构高度复杂且碎片化，存在多种国家监管模式和多个跨境监管机构；2. 监管责任主要在国家层面，欧盟层面权力有限且不均衡；3. 这种制度碎片化与日益跨境整合的市场现实不匹配；4. 更一体化的监管框架可带来四大益处：增强监管有效性、提高监管效率、减少跨境运营企业的复杂性和合规负担、消除阻碍欧盟资本市场跨境整合的监管壁垒
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了评估资本市场监管架构改革的分析框架；2. 提出了监管一体化的指导原则：基于共同标准（如规模和跨境相关性）的一致方法，同时考虑行业特殊性；3. 阐明了欧盟与国家监管机构紧密合作的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟资本市场监管架构改革提供了具体政策建议；2. 识别了监管一体化的关键益处；3. 提供了敏感性分析工具，帮助决策者评估不同改革选项；4. 提出了使一体化监管在实践中有效的治理安排

title: Freight Margins as European Internal Duties
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia, Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and Independent

detail.title: Freight Margins as European Internal Duties

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 13/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of transport and logistics costs as de facto "internal duties" within the European Union, highlighting their impact on the free movement of goods. While formal tariff barriers have been eliminated, frictional costs-arising from distance, infrastructure, and distribution inefficiencies-continue to erode competitiveness and constrain market integration. Using Eurostat COMEXT data and the GTAP social accounting matrix, intra-EU transport margins across six SITC categories and 27 member states are estimated. A Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) simulation of a 50% reduction in intra-EU transport margins suggests aggregate welfare gains of approximately USD 63 billion annually, increased intra-European trade flows, and reduced extra-EU exchanges. The findings underscore the importance of addressing transport and logistics inefficiencies as a priority for EU economic policy, framing them as non-tariff barriers with substantial macroeconomic consequences.

AI.tldr: 该研究将欧盟内部的运输和物流成本视为事实上的"内部关税"，分析其对商品自由流动的影响。研究发现，即使正式关税壁垒已消除，距离、基础设施和分销效率低下产生的摩擦成本仍会削弱竞争力并限制市场一体化。通过CGE模拟，研究发现降低50%的欧盟内部运输成本可带来每年约630亿美元的福利收益，增加欧盟内部贸易，减少与外部贸易。
AI.research_question: 欧盟内部的运输和物流成本如何作为事实上的"内部关税"影响商品自由流动和市场一体化？
AI.motivation: 尽管欧盟已消除正式关税壁垒，但运输和物流成本等摩擦成本仍然存在，这些成本会削弱竞争力并限制市场一体化，需要研究这些非关税壁垒的经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将运输和物流成本视为非关税壁垒的理论框架，借鉴国际贸易理论中关于贸易成本对市场一体化和福利影响的理论。
AI.method: 使用Eurostat COMEXT数据和GTAP社会核算矩阵，估算27个欧盟成员国在6个SITC类别中的欧盟内部运输成本，并进行可计算一般均衡（CGE）模拟，分析降低50%欧盟内部运输成本的影响。
AI.findings: 降低50%的欧盟内部运输成本可带来每年约630亿美元的福利收益，增加欧盟内部贸易流量，减少与欧盟外部的贸易交换。
AI.theory_contributions: 将运输和物流成本概念化为事实上的"内部关税"，为非关税壁垒研究提供了新的理论视角，丰富了关于贸易成本对市场一体化影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟经济政策制定者提供了量化证据，表明解决运输和物流效率低下应作为优先事项，这些措施具有显著的宏观经济影响，有助于促进欧盟内部市场一体化。

title: Fixed Income Factors for India: Term and AAA Corporate Spread Proxies from Benchmark Yield Data
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd

detail.title: Fixed Income Factors for India: Term and AAA Corporate Spread Proxies from Benchmark Yield Data
detail.abstract: This paper constructs two monthly fixed-income factor proxies for India from benchmark yield data: a sovereign term factor (term IN) and an AAA corporate spread factor (credit IN). Because long-history fixed-income total return indices are not consistently available through standard databases, the factors are constructed by mapping benchmark yields into synthetic monthly return proxies using carry, duration, and convexity adjustments. The resulting series are therefore intended as transparent benchmark-exposure proxies rather than as directly observed investable index returns. Using LSEG Datastream benchmark yields for the 10-year Government of India security, the AAA 10-year corporate benchmark, and the 3-month Treasury bill, the paper documents the empirical properties of the two fixed-income proxies over the available sample. term IN , available from May 2007 to February 2026, has an annualised mean of 1.64% and annualised volatility of 6.15%. credit IN , available from June 2012 to February 2026, has an annualised mean of 1.02% and annualised volatility of 4.34%. Validation exercises show that the construction is internally coherent, reproduces benchmark spot-return calculations, and is not highly sensitive to reasonable alternative specifications such as fixed duration or omission of the convexity term. Descriptive regressions on the six Fama-French equity factors for India show that the term proxy is only weakly related to the equity factor set, whereas the AAA corporate spread proxy exhibits more visible comovement with equity size and value factors. The paper's contribution is primarily one of measurement and data construction: it develops a tractable and replicable monthly dataset of Indian fixed-income factor proxies for use in empirical asset-pricing and multi-asset research, while making the assumptions and limitations of benchmark-yield-based construction explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文为印度构建了两个月度固定收益因子代理：主权期限因子（term IN）和AAA级企业利差因子（credit IN）。由于标准数据库中缺乏长期固定收益总回报指数，作者通过基准收益率映射构建合成月度回报代理，并验证了其内部一致性和稳健性。
AI.research_question: 如何为印度市场构建可靠且透明的固定收益因子代理，以支持资产定价和多资产研究？
AI.motivation: 印度市场缺乏长期、一致的固定收益总回报指数数据，这限制了资产定价和多资产研究的开展。需要开发透明、可复制的固定收益因子代理来填补这一数据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期限结构和信用利差理论，利用基准收益率通过持有收益、久期和凸性调整构建合成回报代理。
AI.method: 使用LSEG Datastream的基准收益率数据（10年期印度政府债券、10年期AAA级企业债、3个月国库券），通过carry、duration和convexity调整将基准收益率映射为合成月度回报代理。
AI.findings: term IN（2007年5月-2026年2月）年化均值1.64%，波动率6.15%；credit IN（2012年6月-2026年2月）年化均值1.02%，波动率4.34%。验证表明构建方法内部一致，对替代设定不敏感。term IN与印度Fama-French股票因子关联弱，而credit IN与股票规模和价值因子有更明显的联动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于基准收益率构建固定收益因子代理的透明方法框架，为缺乏完整回报数据的市场提供了可行的测量方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度市场提供了首个可复制、透明的月度固定收益因子代理数据集，可直接用于资产定价模型检验和多资产配置研究。

title: Safety Switches: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Time-Varying Asset Safety

detail.title: Safety Switches: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Time-Varying Asset Safety
detail.abstract: I develop a model-based definition of time-varying sovereign bond safety, and apply it empirically by constructing a news-based index, the FLY, that measures global safe-assets demand. The FLY captures flight-to-safety episodes, the savings glut, and natural interest rate declines. Estimated FLY loadings allow the classification of bonds as safe, neutral, or risky. Post-Great-Recession, the global set of safe assets shrank, but US safety increased. I detect regime switches in FLY loadings: positive switches (becoming safe) align with expansions, higher government spending, lower debt, and credit upgrades; negative switches (becoming risky) are associated with contractions, reduced spending, higher debt, and downgrades.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于模型的时变主权债券安全性定义，并构建了一个新闻基础的FLY指数来测量全球安全资产需求。FLY捕捉了避险事件、储蓄过剩和自然利率下降。通过估计FLY载荷，可将债券分类为安全、中性或风险。后金融危机时期，全球安全资产集合缩小，但美国安全性增加。研究发现FLY载荷存在制度转换：正向转换（变得安全）与经济扩张、政府支出增加、债务减少和信用评级上调相关；负向转换（变得风险）与经济收缩、支出减少、债务增加和评级下调相关。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和测量时变的主权债券安全性？全球安全资产需求如何随时间变化？哪些因素影响主权债券从安全资产转变为风险资产？
AI.motivation: 传统上主权债券被视为安全资产，但其安全性会随时间变化。现有研究缺乏对安全资产时变特性的系统测量方法，需要开发能够捕捉全球安全资产需求动态变化的指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型的安全资产定义框架，结合新闻基础指数构建理论，制度转换理论，以及宏观经济变量与债券安全性关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发基于模型的时变安全性定义方法，构建新闻基础的FLY指数测量全球安全资产需求，使用FLY载荷估计对债券进行分类，应用制度转换模型识别安全性状态变化。
AI.findings: 1. FLY指数有效捕捉了避险事件、储蓄过剩和自然利率下降；2. 后金融危机时期全球安全资产集合缩小，但美国安全性增加；3. 存在制度转换：正向转换与经济扩张、政府支出增加、债务减少和信用评级上调相关；负向转换与经济收缩、支出减少、债务增加和评级下调相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于模型的时变主权债券安全性定义框架；2. 开发了测量全球安全资产需求的新闻基础指数；3. 建立了主权债券安全性分类系统；4. 揭示了安全资产状态转换的宏观经济决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了识别安全资产动态变化的工具；2. 为政策制定者提供了监测主权债券安全性的指标；3. 帮助金融机构进行风险管理和资产配置；4. 为信用评级机构提供了补充分析框架。

title: Special Education Substantially Improves Learning: Evidence from Three States
affiliations: Saint Anselm College, , Syracuse University - Center for Policy Research, New York University (NYU) - Institute for Education and Social Policy, New York University (NYU) - Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service, Boston University, Wheelock College of Education and Human Development and Boston University

detail.title: Special Education Substantially Improves Learning: Evidence from Three States
detail.abstract:
Special education serves more than one in seven U.S. students yet its causal impact remains understudied. Using longitudinal data from Massachusetts, Indiana, and Connecticut, we estimate the effect of individualized supports with an event-study design that tracks achievement around initial classification. Students’ scores decline prior to placement and rise sharply afterward, yielding a consistent V-shaped pattern. Within three years, achievement is 0.2–0.4σ higher than counterfactual trends imply. Gains are similar across disability categories and subgroups, are not driven by testing accommodations, and remain under conservative assumptions. Individualized supports substantially increase learning productivity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用马萨诸塞州、印第安纳州和康涅狄格州的纵向数据，通过事件研究设计评估特殊教育个性化支持对学生学业成绩的因果影响，发现学生在接受特殊教育后成绩显著提升0.2-0.4个标准差。
AI.research_question: 特殊教育的个性化支持对学生学业成绩有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 特殊教育服务覆盖了美国七分之一以上的学生，但其因果影响尚未得到充分研究，需要实证证据来评估特殊教育干预措施的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育干预的因果推断理论，采用事件研究设计来追踪学生接受特殊教育前后的学业表现变化。
AI.method: 使用马萨诸塞州、印第安纳州和康涅狄格州的纵向数据，采用事件研究设计追踪学生在首次被分类为特殊教育需求前后的学业成绩变化。
AI.findings: 学生的成绩在接受特殊教育前下降，接受后显著上升，呈现一致的V型模式；三年内学业成绩比反事实趋势高出0.2-0.4个标准差；这种提升在不同残疾类别和亚组中相似，且不是由考试便利措施驱动的。
AI.theory_contributions: 为特殊教育的因果效应提供了实证证据，证明了事件研究设计在教育干预评估中的有效性，丰富了教育政策因果推断的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了特殊教育有效性的实证支持，表明个性化支持能显著提高学习效率，有助于优化特殊教育资源配置和干预策略。

title: How Do Cryptocurrencies Price Economic News?
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: How Do Cryptocurrencies Price Economic News?
detail.abstract: We use novel intraday data to study the price discovery process in cryptocurrency markets around U.S. monetary policy, inflation, and labor market announcements. Our analysis reveals the following: (1) volatility, trading volume, and bid-ask spreads rise sharply at announcement times and remain elevated for up to 30 minutes relative to comparable non-announcement intervals, indicating that cryptocurrency investors pay attention to these announcements and that information is quickly incorporated; (2) announcement surprises associated with higher yields or "risk-off" conditions cause substantial cryptocurrency price declines - pointing to a potential strengthening of U.S. monetary policy transmission to the real economy in recent years; (3) the time-varying magnitude and direction of price reactions more closely resemble those of U.S. equities than those of fiat currencies or commodities, suggesting that cryptocurrencies behave primarily as risk-sensitive assets; (4) price impact estimates of order flow around announcements are consistent with rising institutional participation in cryptocurrency markets and their crucial role for price discovery.

AI.tldr: 使用日内数据研究加密货币市场在美国货币政策、通胀和劳动力市场公告期间的价格发现过程，发现加密货币对宏观经济公告反应强烈，表现出风险敏感资产特征，机构参与度提升。
